title: Massachusetts Schedule II prescription validity
rule_summary: A Massachusetts written or electronic Schedule II prescription becomes invalid 30 days after its issue date.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply schedule ii validity requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing schedule ii validity with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
